skill_checksum_method: from skill/: sort relative file paths, excluding __pycache__ and *.pyc; run sha256sum in that order; SHA-256 the resulting records
compatibility_note: v6 accepts one- or two-PDF Expensas statements (liquidación mandatory, recibo optional) and maps AGIP to the ABL service; v6 scores are not directly comparable with v5 for messages exercising those paths
